bio: For Vaultkeepers like Stullda, they will lay down their lives in defense of tradition. Her Vault houses thousands of memory gems – the crystalline histories of thousands of Deepcast families. Not the most exciting treasure on paper, but Stullda knows that the knowledge contains within her Vault is worth its weight in gold.
